name: Tabbit
desc: Meituan's AI-native browser that runs tasks across pages and apps
desc_zh: 美团出的 AI 原生浏览器，能跨网页和软件跑任务
solves: A weekly report means copying data between tabs and desktop apps. Tabbit does the clicking and filling in one instruction.
solves_zh: 每周做报表要在十几个标签页和几个软件之间来回倒数据。说一句话，它自己点、自己填，最后交出结果。
best_for: Every Monday the same eleven browser steps produce the same operations report.
best_for_zh: 每周一都要在浏览器里重复同样的十一步，导出同一份运营报表。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：C — 澎湃/东方财富 reporting on the 2026-03-02 public beta; D — https://www.meituan.com）。 Built by 美团旗下 GN06 (光年之外) team. First public day is the free public beta of 2026-03-02; version 1.0 went live 2026-06-09. The official newsroom page reprints a 经济参考网 report but is published on meituan.com with its own date, and it is the only first-party page found that carries the 3月2日 beta date. macOS and Windows clients, no invite code during the beta; the release says the agent task success rate rose from 53.1% in March to 91.8%. Not in the 2026-05-07 window for 1.0 but the product itself first shipped inside it, and neither 妙手 (CatPaw) nor 问小团 covers a browser. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：AI 浏览器在账本里的分类是 search（ChatGPT Atlas 的记法），保持一致。 首次公开日期来源：https://www.meituan.com/news/NN260612179003187
